summary: Walks a singly linked list starting from the head pointer stored at this+0x13C (this[79]). For each node it compares the node's name string (reached through the pointer at node+28) against the search key a2 using strcmp; on a match it returns the node pointer, otherwise it advances through the next pointer at node+36. Returns 0 for an empty list and when the end of the list is reached without a match.

local_names.v2: current node pointer, starting from the list head at this[79]

operations.description: Load the list head v2 = this[79] (dword at this+0x13C) as the starting node.
If the head pointer is null the list is empty; return 0 immediately.
While strcmp(a2, *(node+28)+28) is non-zero (node name string does not equal a2), keep walking; a zero strcmp exits the loop with v2 as the matching node.
In the walk step, if the next-node pointer at node+36 is null the end of the list was reached without a match; return 0.
Advance to the next node: v2 = *(node+36).
Return v2, the pointer to the first node whose name matches a2.
